rows.44:675c:
A bullet grazed past the side of {f:my|my} head.
When I looked, a police officer, probably called in by someone, was aiming a gun at {f:me|me}.{p}
rows.44:6e98:
Kazama had been smiling all this time.
Now that he was finally alone with {f:me|me}, his face was probably relaxing into an even bigger grin{f:.|.}
"You're bolder than I thought.
I need you to think a little more before you act, though.
It'd be bad if our mission got exposed, wouldn't it?
Well, what's done is done.
Now, comrade, let's start our briefing."
Kazama said happily.{p}
rows.44:87c8:
...It showed the whole course of {f:my|my} life, from being born on Sunbararia to growing up.
These images seemed to show {f:me|me} as I was recently.
{f:I|I} had a wife and three children.
Oh, now {f:my|my} wife and children are crying.
This seems to be the day before {f:I|I} was dispatched to Earth.
And so, before reaching Earth, {f:I|I} lost my memory in an accident...
"Now, open your eyes."
Kazama's voice echoed.{p}
rows.44:8990:
"{f:Whoa|Eek}! K-Kazama★ A monster☆"
{f:I|I} had cried out loud without meaning to.
Standing there was not Kazama, but a monster with an ammonite-like head{f:!|!}
"What are you so surprised about? This is our true form, isn't it?"
the thing said.
"Honestly, the things you say. We've looked like this since the day we were born."
On an impulse, {f:I|I} looked at my reflection in the window glass.
"..............................{f:No way|No way}★"{p}
rows.44:9210:
"Ugh!"
And {f:what do you know|what do you know}, in my blurry vision I saw Kazama, transformed beyond recognition.
He had something like an ammonite on his head, and tentacles came slithering out of his hands and mouth.
Startled, {f:I|I} tried somehow to get away, but my body wouldn't move.
Meanwhile, its tentacles came stretching closer and closer to {f:my|my} body{f:.|.}
The slimy tentacles were crawling all over {f:my|my} skin.
They squirmed, trying to work their way into {f:my|my} nose and mouth and ears.
And yet, my body felt better and better.
{f:I|I} began to think that, with a pleasure like this, it didn't matter what happened to me anymore.{p}
rows.44:94a4:
{f:I|I} can't let this go on☆
With that thought, {f:I|I} put all my strength into my body.{p}
rows.44:a0c0:
{f:What|Excuse me}?
Wait{f: a minute| a second}, {f:I|I} never said yes{f:!|!}☆
Hey☆
...No answer at all.
Geez, don't just decide things on your own☆
These Bohheritians sure are pushy.{p}...Oh well, whatever.
Still, it's kind of cool, isn't it?
Being a hunter...{p}
rows.44:a8ac:
{f:I|I} gave myself up to him and let him do as he pleased.
The Sunbararian's tentacles wormed their way through the gaps in {f:my|my} clothes, pushing farther and farther in.
I could feel the fine, hair-thin tips of the tentacles working into every hole in my body.
I could no longer move my body at all.
"It's no use. You can't fool us Sunbararians. These tentacles can see right through your lies."
With that, the thing spread its tentacles even wider and wrapped {f:me|me} up.{p}
rows.44:ac14:
"Heh..."
{f:I|I} laughed.
Laugh or cry... that was all I could think of.
Then I'll laugh for all I'm worth!
"Wahahahahahahaha☆"
Kazama stayed completely silent.
Uh-oh!
Looks like I made him angry{f:.|.}
Was my laugh a little too arrogant?
Even so, it's not like I can stop right away...
Then, with a deadly serious expression, Kazama got up from his seat and strode straight toward {f:me|me}.{p}
rows.44:b530:
I have to steer this onto some other topic...
"You're really cool, Kazama. I bet you go out with lots of girls at once, don't you? Lucky you. You ladykiller☆ {f:I'm|I'm} so jealous. I bet you made plenty of girls cry on Sunbararia too."
I just said whatever popped into my head.
Kazama's expression stiffened.
He was making a sour face.
Oh no, it looks like this plan {f:failed|failed}.
Oh, here goes nothing.{p}
rows.44:b97c:
"Kazama, don't you feel anything, watching {f:my|my} dance?"
{f:I|I} finally lost patience and asked.
An unexpected answer came back from Kazama.
"On the contrary, I'm deeply moved. Truly... I never knew such a moving dance existed. What have I been looking at all this time on Earth? It's beautiful, utterly beautiful, {a}!"
Great, the conversation {f:had|had} gotten sidetracked nicely.
"Huh, wh-what...? My body {f:won't|won't} listen to me★"{p}
rows.44:c86c:
"{f:You bet|That's right}, {f:I'm|I'm} an assassin who works for whoever {f:pays|pays}.
As long as I get paid, I always kill the target I'm hired for☆"
Saying that, {f:I|I} pointed my index finger at Kazama.
"Eek! Eeeek☆"
Kazama was cowering in a corner of the club room, trembling.{p}
rows.44:ca14:
{f:I|I} looked down at him as he crouched there trembling, and said,{p}"{f:Listen, Sunbararian|Listen, Mr. Sunbararian}, {f:take my advice|take my advice}. {f:Get off Earth, now|Leave Earth at once}.
{f:I've|I've} got no grudge against {f:you|you}{f:, but|, but} my client ordered me to dispose of the aliens on this Earth{f:, see|, you see}.
My client?
{f:The people of this Earth, that's who|The people of this Earth}.
It {f:looks like|seems} your invasion of Earth has been well and truly exposed.
{f:What a bunch of idiots|How foolish of you}.
If you leave Earth without a word, I won't lay a {f:finger|finger} on you."{p}
rows.44:e948:
"Right, right. We Sunbararians have skin that's sooo delicate.
When the UV rays increase, our skin cells get destroyed in no time.
I see, I had no idea Earth was in such a dangerous state.
Understood. Let's arrange the withdrawal of all Sunbararians on Earth right away."
Kazama... no, the Sunbararian took out something like a patch and raised one hand.{p}
